reviews.title: Ineffective! Useless!!
reviews.text: A waste of my time and money! Went through instructions numerous times, followed directions videos to a T! Spam calls, telemarketers , robo calls, continued to come through! I troubleshooted the problem 3 TIMES through their own support and received no resolution! Just a broken communication. Don’t bother with this app, it’s useless!! Caution! Once it takes over your phone it’s not so easy to remove either. Had to contact Apple to remove the RealCall features from my phone. Finally, had to do a HARD RESET. Consumer BEWARE! Can’t get a refund either, the developer didn’t help one bit to right what they wronged.

reviews.title: Also Blocks Important Calls and Texts
reviews.text: If you have an IPhone you can just turn your silence unknown numbers feature and it will silence all numbers that are not saved. The thing I like about Real Call is the fact that you don’t have see the call coming in, unlike the unsaved number feature, it blocks it completely. But the bad thing is it blocks important calls and text. I missed calls from Door Dashers marked spam likely. Verification texts. Appointment reminder texts. Missed important calls from my job. Missed appointment confirmation calls. I would’ve purchased it if it proved that it worked but it is not worth it. Save your money or just use the feee version.

reviews.title: Trying to cancel within the seven day free trial
reviews.text: I installed this program last night, and it is not working on my iPhone. There’s a conflict between that and another program that I have, and it keeps turning itself off and wanting me to reconfigure the settings. I have already received Spam calls this morning.   I sent a note to your support department to tell them that I wanted to cancel, and I have heard nothing My credit card has been charged for the entire year, and I want to make sure that I get this reversed. I am canceling well within my trial period. Would Somebody please respond to this. Thank you.

reviews.title: It’s a Scam, Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: This does not work; and their customer service is horrible. They were unhelpful and rude. I ended up requesting a refund from Apple because they would not give me one - so I had to go all the way through the app to get my money back. I do not recommend that you get this - it does not work. I was getting over 30 spam calls a day and this didn’t stop any of them. It still rang through. Also, setting it up is confusing. I constantly set it up the way that they asked me to and it was lengthy and still didn’t work.

reviews.title: Does not work.
reviews.text: I paid for the premium version of this app and I still get 25-30 calls per day. This app is a waste of time and money. Do not purchase. I’ve tried to get a refund because I was testing before purchasing and I ended up paying for the service, and it does not work. If you do try it, be sure to cancel before the last day. There is no customer service. I would gladly pay for a service that works, but this one absolutely does not. I’ve not seen a change in the calls at all since I paid for it. I can’t stress enough how big of a rip off this app is.
